ZMB.note: The notice covers ID and CRVS core modules and enrolment kits; no authentication service is stated.

facts.fact: The Smart Zambia Institute's World Bank-listed request for proposals (issued 3 December 2025) seeks one system integrator to deploy, customise and integrate the foundational digital ID and CRVS core modules, including data migration.

systems.system: Foundational Digital ID and CRVS core modules

facts.fact: The Smart Zambia Institute issued a request for proposals on 3 December 2025, financed by IDA under the Digital Zambia Acceleration Project, to procure a system integrator for the CRVS core modules, backend infrastructure and enrolment kits.

ZMB.note: No government online service is stated.
No number at birth is stated.
The notice is a procurement of an integrator; it says nothing of who will operate, maintain or own the system.
No register keyed on the ID number is stated.

facts.fact: The Smart Zambia Institute's request for proposals, issued 3 December 2025 under the IDA-financed Digital Zambia Acceleration Project, procures a system integrator to develop and deploy the foundational digital ID, backend infrastructure and enrolment kits.

ZMB.note: The notice buys the build from an outside integrator but does not state that government staff cannot run it.

facts.fact: The Government of Zambia has received International Development Association financing under the Digital Zambia Acceleration Project, part of which the Smart Zambia Institute will apply to the CRVS core modules integrator contract.
